consoleSteps.step: github.com/settings/applications/new filled: name "Greenlight test", homepage, redirect URI = Composio callback
observed: Redirect URIs: up to 10, optional wildcard matching
"Expire user access tokens" checked by default

consoleSteps.step: Register application → "Application created successfully", app id 3988988, 0 users, no review
Generate a new client secret → GitHub required "Confirm access" (sudo) by the account owner; secret never stored or logged
Connect Link → GitHub consent "Authorize Greenlight test" (PKCE S256; scopes requested by the Composio auth config: repo user gist notifications project workflow codespace)
Owner clicked Authorize → "Successfully connected Composio to GitHub"

browser: User's own Google Chrome (signed in) driven via Claude in Chrome; human performed sign-in, sudo confirmation and the Authorize click.
